columns.name: id
columns.description: Surrogate primary key for the stock record.

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock keeping unit; part of the (sku, location) addressing key (PI2).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Storage location; part of the (sku, location) addressing key (PI2).

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Inventory classification code carried by every filed record (PI2).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stored stock level; must be >= 0 (PI3) and is never null (PI2).

columns.name: updated_by
columns.description: Actor who filed/last adjusted the record; retained for the immutable audit key (NFR-F1-1).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the last file/adjustment; retained for the immutable audit key (NFR-F1-1).

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with columns id (uuid PK, default gen_random_uuid()), sku (text NOT NULL), location (text NOT NULL), inventory_code (text NOT NULL), quantity (integer NOT NULL default 0), updated_by (text NOT NULL), updated_at (timestamptz NOT NULL default now()). Add composite UNIQUE (sku, location) and CHECK (quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive create-only migration (PI5): downgrade drops stock_records; no existing table is altered, so prior data in other tables is preserved (NFR-F1-1/R1). The unique constraint on (sku, location) is what the repository's single-transaction read-then-write upserts against so a concurrent repeat file collapses to one row (PI4).
